notes: Always run the routing Worker before static assets. Default asset-first routing incorrectly serves the Verify index at the main homepage and Verify-local robots at the domain robots URL.
Keep assets and all three bindings on subsequent deployments. Secret values are intentionally absent from this manifest.

Legacy version upload with keep_assets=true preserved the old asset routing configuration despite submitted run_worker_first=true. A guarded JSON Merge Patch to /workers/workers/{worker_id}/versions/latest applied the routing correction while inheriting assets/modules/bindings.
Production homepage, robots, helpline, Verify, DPIIT and Ask checks all passed.

Version54 also fixes HEAD requests with Content-Length:0 by constructing a fresh upstream GET and removing request body framing headers. PowerShell GET/HEAD and curl HEAD with Content-Length:0 passed; all six live page regressions passed.
